metadata.title: The Non-Abelian X-Ray Transform on Simple Asymptotically Hyperbolic Surfaces
metadata.abstract: We prove a gauge equivalence result for the non-Abelian X-ray transform with connection and Higgs field on simple 2-dimensional asymptotically hyperbolic spaces. Our approach is based on the construction of holomorphic integrating factors. To construct these, we analyze the geodesic X-ray transform on functions on simple asymptotically hyperbolic manifolds of general dimension and prove polyhomogeneous mapping properties and a surjectivity result for the adjoint.

analysis.topic: 几何分析、几何 PDE 与几何流
analysis.progressType: 非阿贝尔射线变换的规范唯一性
analysis.workSummary: 在二维简单渐近双曲空间上，对带联络和Higgs场的非阿贝尔X-ray变换证明规范等价结果。方法构造全纯积分因子；为此先在任意维简单渐近双曲流形上分析函数测地X-ray变换，建立多重齐次映射性质及伴随算子的满射性。
techniques: 测地射线变换的多重齐次分析
analysis.breakthrough: 把非紧渐近双曲端的解析控制接入二维非阿贝尔逆问题，得到规范意义的识别。
analysis.limitations: 最终联络/Higgs规范等价为二维，任意维推广仅针对基础函数变换工具；简单性及渐近双曲条件不能删去，摘要未给场的边界衰减与规范边界条件。 当前数学解读依据摘要，尚未逐步审读证明。

analysis.priorityReason: 负曲率几何与分析逆问题的直接交叉。
